RNA pathway enrichment shows 22 significant pathways (q<0.05) including HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION; WXS mutation enrichment identifies missense and TMB differences; CNV shows chr20q, chr7p, chr7q, chr2p differences vs rest, supporting a distinct biological identity.

RNA pathway enrichment shows no significant pathways (q<0.05); WXS mutation enrichment shows no significant features; CNV shows no significant features vs rest, providing weak biological support for a distinct identity.
